)

        symbol_names[name].append((fpath, pkg))

# Count call sites using rg for each unique function name
# For common names this is noisy, so we'll use qualified search patterns

call_counts = {}

for (name, fpath), _ in symbols.items():
    # Skip very short names and test helpers that are likely false positives

        files_with_calls.discard('')
        
        # Count actual call occurrences (not just files)
        result2 = subprocess.run(
            ['rg', '-c', '--glob', '*.go', rf'\b{re.escape(name)}\s*\(', '.'],
            capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='/bench/repo'
        )
        total_calls = 0
        for line in result2.stdout.strip().split('\n'):

        # Subtract definition(s) in internal file
        with open(fpath, 'r') as f:
            def_content = f.read()
        defs = len(re.findall(rf'^func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?{re.escape(name)}\s*\(', def_content, re.MULTILINE))
        total_calls = max(0, total_calls - defs)
        
        call_counts[(name, fpath)] = total_calls
    except Exception as e:

# Sort by call count

# AGENTS.md

Repository instructions for AI coding agents. Keep this file short, concrete, and tied to commands that actually work in this
repo. If a fact here conflicts with source files or CI config, trust the source file and update this guide.

## Project Snapshot

Memos is a self-hosted note-taking app.

- Backend: Go 1.26.2, Echo v5, Connect RPC, gRPC-Gateway, Protocol Buffers.
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript 6, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, React Query v5.
- Storage: SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL.
- Generated API outputs: `proto/gen/` for Go/OpenAPI, `web/src/types/proto/` for TypeScript.

## Working Rules

- Read relevant code before editing; prefer local patterns over new abstractions.
- Keep diffs scoped. Do not do repo-wide cleanup, dependency churn, or generated-file rewrites unless the task requires it.
- Do not hand-edit generated proto outputs. Change `.proto` files, then run `buf generate`.
- Add migrations for all database drivers when schema changes, and update each driver's `LATEST.sql`.
- Add public API endpoints to `server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go`.
- Ask before adding heavy dependencies, changing auth/token behavior, or altering Docker/release workflows.

## Commands

Run from the repository root unless a command starts with `cd`.

```bash
# Backend
go run ./cmd/memos --port 8081    # Start backend dev server
go test ./...                      # Run all Go tests
go test -v ./store/...             # Store tests, including DB drivers via TestContainers
go test -v -race ./server/...      # Server tests with race detector
go test -v -race ./internal/...    # Internal package tests with race detector
go test -v -run TestFoo ./pkg/...  # Run matching Go tests
go mod tidy -go=1.26.2             # Match CI tidy check
golangci-lint run                  # Go lint, config: .golangci.yaml
golangci-lint run --fix            # Auto-fix lint, including goimports

# Frontend
cd web && pnpm install             # Install dependencies
cd web && pnpm dev                 # Dev server on :3001, proxying API to :8081
cd web && pnpm lint                # Type check + Biome lint
cd web && pnpm test                # Vitest unit tests
cd web && pnpm build               # Production build
cd web && pnpm release             # Build SPA into server/router/frontend/dist

# Protocol Buffers
cd proto && buf generate           # Regenerate Go + TypeScript + OpenAPI
cd proto && buf lint               # Lint proto files
cd proto && buf format -w          # Format proto files
```

# Extract all function/method declarations from internal files

while IFS= read -r f; do
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    name=$(echo "$line" | sed -n 's/^func \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p')
    recv=""
    method=0
    if echo "$line" | grep -q '^func ('; then
      method=1
      recv=$(echo "$line" | sed -n 's/^func (\([^)]*\)).*/\1/p' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/\*//' | awk '{print $NF}')
      name=$(echo "$line" | sed -n 's/^func ([^)]*) \+\([^(]*\).*/\1/p')
    fi
    key="${name}|${recv}|${method}"
    decl_file[$key]="$f"
    decl_recv[$key]="$recv"
    decl_method[$key]="$method"
  done < <(grep -E '^func ' "$f")
done < /tmp/internal_go.txt

echo "Total internal symbols: ${#decl_file[@]}"

# For each symbol, count calls
declare -A counts

  name="${key%%|*}"
  rest="${key#*|}"
  recv="${rest%%|*}"
  method="${rest##*|}"

Building a more accurate script to count inbound calls.

Package-level functions are counted by finding all call sites across the repository and subtracting the definition itself. Methods are counted by matching exact patterns like `.MethodName(`. The script will tally actual call sites per symbol under `internal/`.

Common method names like Len, Swap, and Error would create false positives. # Improved fan-in: per symbol, count all call sites minus defs
# For methods with common names, skip unless name appears <=3 times as decl in whole repo outside internal duplicate

count_symbol() {
  local name="$1" kind="$2" f="$3" pkg="$4"
  local pkgdir; pkgdir=$(dirname "$f")
  local fullpkg="${mod}/${pkgdir#./}"
  local total=0
  
  if [ "$kind" = "method" ]; then
    total=$(grep -r --include="*.go" -E "\.${name}\s*\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/\.git/' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    local defs=$(grep -cE "^func \([^)]*\) ${name}\s*\(" "$f" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); defs=${defs:-0}
    total=$((total - defs))
  else
    # unqualified in same package dir
    local uq=$(grep -r --include="*.go" -E "(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_.])${name}\s*\(" "$pkgdir" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    local defs=$(grep -cE "^func ${name}\s*\(" "$pkgdir" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); defs=${defs:-0}
    total=$uq
    # subtract all defs in package (may over-subtract for overloaded names - rare in Go)
    total=$((total - defs))
    # qualified from importers
    while IFS= read -r importer; do
      [ -z "$importer" ] && continue
      [[ "$importer" == "$pkgdir"* ]] && continue
      local line=$(grep "${fullpkg}" "$importer" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
      [ -z "$line" ] && continue
      local alias="$pkg"
      if echo "$line" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]+[a-zA-Z0-9_]+[[:space:]]+"'; then
        alias=$(echo "$line" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)[[:space:]]+.*/\1/')
      fi
      local c=$(grep -E "${alias}\.${name}\s*\(" "$importer" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      total=$((total + c))
    done < <(grep -rl --include="*.go" "${fullpkg}" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/\.git/' || true)
  fi
  [ "$total" -lt 0 ] && total=0
  echo "$total"
}

# Common method names likely false positives
COMMON="Len|Less|Swap|Error|String|Validate|Next|Start|Stop|Register|Compile|Parse|New|Kind|init|matches|Close|Open|Read|Write|Run|Do|Get|Set|ServeHTTP|Serve|Handle|Format|Transcribe|Render|Field|Stop|Len|Swap"

> /tmp/all_fanin.tsv

  pkg=$(grep -m1 '^package ' "$f" | awk '{print $2}')
  if [ "$kind" = "method" ]; then
    # skip very common method names

done < /tmp/symbols.tsv

echo "=== Also check common methods with type-specific search ==="

count_symbol() {
  local name="$1" kind="$2" f="$3" pkg="$4"
  local pkgdir; pkgdir=$(dirname "$f")
  local fullpkg="${mod}/${pkgdir#./}"
  local total=0
  
  if [ "$kind" = "method" ]; then
    total=$(grep -r --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" -E "\.${name}\s*\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/\.git/' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    local defs=$(grep -cE "^func \([^)]*\) ${name}\s*\(" "$f" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); defs=${defs:-0}
    total=$((total - defs))
  else
    local uq=$(grep -r --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" -E "(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_.])${name}\s*\(" "$pkgdir" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    local defs=$(grep -r --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" -cE "^func ${name}\s*\(" "$pkgdir" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END{print s+0}')
    total=$((uq - defs))
    while IFS= read -r importer; do
      [ -z "$importer" ] && continue
      [[ "$importer" == "$pkgdir"* ]] && continue
      local line=$(grep "${fullpkg}" "$importer" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
      [ -z "$line" ] && continue
      local alias="$pkg"
      if echo "$line" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]+[a-zA-Z0-9_]+[[:space:]]+"'; then
        alias=$(echo "$line" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)[[:space:]]+.*/\1/')
      fi
      local c=$(grep -E "${alias}\.${name}\s*\(" "$importer" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      total=$((total + c))
    done < <(grep -rl --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" "${fullpkg}" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/\.git/' || true)
  fi
  [ "$total" -lt 0 ] && total=0
  echo "$total"
}

while IFS=$'\t' read -r name kind recv f; do
  if [ "$kind" = "method" ]; then
    d=$(grep -r --include="*.go" -E "^func \([^)]*\) ${name}\s*\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -vc '/\.git/')
    [ "$d" -ne 1 ] && continue
    t=$(grep -r --include="*.go" -E "\.${name}\s*\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -vc '/\.git/')
    c=$((t-1))
  else
    d=$(grep -r --include="*.go" -E "^func ${name}\s*\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -vc '/\.git/')
    [ "$d" -ne 1 ] && continue
    t=$(grep -r --include="*.go" -E "(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_.])${name}\s*\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -vc '/\.git/')
    c=$((t-1))
  fi
  [ "$c" -ge 20 ] && printf '%d\t%s\t%s\n' "$c" "$name" "$f"
done < /tmp/symbols2.tsv >> /tmp/brute.tsv
sort -t$'\t' -k1 -rn /tmp/brute.tsv
